brief.headline: Revenue rose 39.9% to 13150 while sessions fell 4.6%, with conversion rate up 46.8% to 0.82.
executive_summary: This week's revenue was 13150, up 39.9% from 9402.
Sessions were 27707, down 4.6% from 29029, while conversion rate rose.
Conversion rate was 0.82, up 46.8% from 0.56, and revenue per session was 0.47, up 46.5% from 0.32.
This is Google's public obfuscated GA4 sample, not a real client.

what_changed.title: Revenue and transactions rose
what_changed.detail: Revenue was 13150 vs 9402, change_pct 39.9; transactions were 253 vs 170, change_pct 48.8.

what_changed.title: Traffic fell
what_changed.detail: Sessions were 27707 vs 29029, change_pct -4.6; users were 23375 vs 24710, change_pct -5.4.

what_changed.title: Conversion improved
what_changed.detail: Conversion rate was 0.82 vs 0.56, change_pct 46.8; add to cart to checkout was 42.15 vs 35.94, change_pct 17.3.

what_changed.title: Some segments moved more than total
what_changed.detail: Mobile revenue was 6357, revenue_change_pct 87.8; Canada revenue was 1638, revenue_change_pct 283.6; total revenue change_pct was 39.9.

likely_drivers: No calendar events are provided, so the lift is not explained by a known seasonal event.
The revenue lift is consistent with conversion rate rising from 0.56 to 0.82 and revenue per session rising from 0.32 to 0.47.
The improvement is likely supported by the add-to-cart to checkout step rising from 35.94 to 42.15.
New-purchaser revenue rose from 8321 to 12041, while returning-purchaser revenue was 1147, so the week likely relied more on new buyers.
risks: If sessions continue to fall, the conversion lift may not offset the traffic decline.
AOV fell to 51.98, so revenue per transaction may weaken if basket value does not recover.
Source attribution is incomplete, with 24.4% of session source rows unusable, so channel performance may be misread.
High-interest products with zero purchase lines may leave demand unconverted.

actions.action: Validate the source attribution and funnel data behind the conversion lift before using it for channel decisions.
actions.why: The conversion lift is large, but source data quality is incomplete.
actions.evidence: conversion_rate current 0.82 vs previous 0.56, change_pct 46.8; session source unusable_pct 24.4.

actions.action: Run a CRO test on the cart-to-checkout flow to confirm the improvement is stable.
actions.why: The cart-to-checkout step improved and is likely contributing to the conversion lift.
actions.evidence: Add to cart -> checkout current 42.15 vs previous 35.94, change_pct 17.3; conversion_rate current 0.82 vs previous 0.56.

actions.action: Audit the product page and purchase path for the five high-interest low-conversion products.
actions.why: These products have views and adds but no purchase lines, so demand may not be converting.
actions.evidence: Google Blue Stojo Cup views_cur 1099, adds_to_cart_cur 221, purchase_lines_cur 0; Google Cloud Unisex Zip Hoodie views_cur 2051, adds_to_cart_cur 521, purchase_lines_cur 0.

data_caveats: This is Google's public obfuscated GA4 sample, not a real client.
No calendar events are provided, so seasonality cannot be confirmed.
Treat source breakdowns with caution: 24.4% of sessions rows are unknown or obfuscated.
Session-level source is available for 73.5% of sessions; the rest use the user's first-touch source.
